Asana used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra in Codex to optimize its browser agent, achieving a 76x cost reduction and a 5x speed improvement in tests.

Why it matters: Drastic improvements in model efficiency and execution speed make running complex, automated browser agents economically and operationally viable at enterprise scale.

entry.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
entry.summary:
Sophos implemented OpenAI Daybreak to reduce cyber-threat investigation times by 96% and automate over half of its Managed Detection and Response cases.

Why it matters: Integrating OpenAI Daybreak into security workflows drastically lowers incident response times and automates majority MDR workloads without removing human oversight.

entry.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
entry.summary:
Oracle has deployed ChatGPT Work and Codex across its recruiting, engineering, and operations teams to automate specialist workflows and reduce tasks from days to minutes.

Why it matters: Integrating generative AI and code generation models into core enterprise operations significantly accelerates software development lifecycles and business workflows.
